newsitem.title: USA: Onyx sees higher operating costs.
newsitem.headline: Onyx sees higher operating costs.

text.p: Onyx Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it anticipates increased operating expenses stemming from the development of Onyx-015, its first therapeutic virus product.
The company said it has moved Onyx-015 into a phase II efficacy trial, following the completion of a phase I study in the second quarter.
"We expect total operating expenses to increase as we continue to expand the clinical development of Onyx-015," company treasurer Douglas Blankenship said in a news release.
Blankenship was not available to provide further details, or to answer questions on the size and duration of increased expense levels. or the impact on future earnings.
Through the first half of the year, the company has reported expenses totaling $11.6 million versus $8.9 million a year ago.
Onyx-015 is used as a therapy for patients with recurrent and refractory head and neck cancer, the company said.

Also Wednesday, Onyx reported a widened second quarter loss of $3.8 million, or $0.39 per share, versus a loss of $2.4 million, or $0.29 per share, a year ago. Total expenses for the quarter were $6.4 million versus $4.6 million last year.
